Aisha Khan: Quick heads up — I'm going to run a CRM hygiene dry-run on staging tonight 10:00pm PT. Goal: dedupe, stale contact purge, and healthscore recalculation (v4 thresholds). Will run in dry-run mode so no writes.
Tom Reyes: 👍 which dataset and playbook version?
Aisha Khan: dataset: staging_customers_2026_02. playbook: cs_playbook_v12. I pushed a config PR: https://git.redwood/infra/cs-playbooks/pull/312 — includes new "reactivation_eligibility" rule.
Priya Patel: Can you confirm the healthscore formula change? Last time we toggled decay factor and that caused false positives.
Aisha Khan: Yes — decay factor back to 0.85, reweight product_usage -> +10%, support_tickets -> -5%. I ran a sample SQL to compare scores:
Aisha Khan: ```sql
SELECT id, old_score, new_score FROM staging_scores LIMIT 10;
``` 
Tom Reyes: Nice. Any opt-outs for customers in pilot? We shouldn't touch accounts in "enablement:pilot" tag.
Aisha Khan: Good catch — exclusion clause added. Query includes `WHERE NOT tags @> ARRAY['enablement:pilot']`.
Lena Ortiz: @Aisha can you drop a quick summary of expected delta counts? Ops wants numbers for change window.
Aisha Khan: Dry-run results: 1) duplicates flagged: 4,312 (potential merge candidates) 2) stale contacts to archive: 2,021 3) customers with score change >=10 pts: 1,156. I'll paste CSV to the channel after the run.
Priya Patel: For playbook automation — are canary rules on? We should route high-risk (>70% churn probability) to Manual-review queue first.
Aisha Khan: Canary is enabled: first 200 matches -> manual_review queue, then automated playbook. Config snippet in PR.
onboard-bot: dry-run scheduled by Aisha Khan at 2026-03-21T22:00:00Z — job id run-3923456789-01. Status: queued.
Tom Reyes: Thanks. If results look clean, can we schedule the write-run window tomorrow 2am PT? Need to sync with infra.
Aisha Khan: Yes — tentatively 2am PT tom. I'll coordinate with infra and post windows. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Lena Ortiz: Post the CSV and a short rollback plan once you have the run logs.
Aisha Khan: Will do.
